# couchbase-capella-aidp_model (Data Source)

Fetches a Capella AI model by organization_id and id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_model" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  id              = var.model_id
}
```
